18 open-source Peloton projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Peloton bikes and treads. 5 of 18 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: peloton-to-garmin, gymnasticon, Openpelo, peloton-client-library, pelomon.
